mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three months signals an easing monetary policy cycle, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of triggered instances during easing periods, or the 20d returns are not statistically significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% triggers a contractionary labor market response, reducing corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains below 5.0% for the next 3 months despite initial spikes, or 5d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals a robust economic expansion, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase by >2% over the prior month
failure_condition: The interaction does not hold (one or both proxies decline), or 60d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index signals approaching peak inflation, prompting central banks to adjust policy, which compresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL decreases by >1.5% over the prior month
failure_condition: The late-cycle expansion regime is not active, or CPIAUCSL does not decrease sufficiently, or 20d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in housing demand (HOUST) above 2004 units triggers a construction boom and increased consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises >400 units in a month
failure_condition: HOUST remains below 2004 units for the next month, or 5d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals conflicting policy signals, creating market uncertainty and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.5% AND UNRATE decreases by >0.2pp over the prior month
failure_condition: The interaction does not occur (one or both proxies move oppositely), or 20d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A confluence of rising corporate demand (RSAFS) and falling federal funds rates signals accommodative monetary policy and robust business activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by >2% AND FEDFUNDS decreases by >1% over the prior month
failure_condition: The interaction does not hold (one or both proxies move oppositely), or 60d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a combination of falling unemployment (UNRATE) and easing monetary policy (FEDFUNDS) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.5% AND FEDFUNDS decreases by >0.5% over the prior month
failure_condition: The post-shock recovery regime is not active, or the interaction does not occur, or 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
